name: NormalizeDateFormatsNode
label: Normalize Date Formats
description: Parses date values (strings or DateTime) from one or more columns using multiple common formats and rewrites them to a single target output format. Unparseable values are left unchanged.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the date columns to normalize.

fields.name: ColumnsToNormalize
fields.label: Columns To Normalize
fields.description: Comma-separated column names whose date values are normalized.

fields.name: OutputFormat
fields.label: Output Format
fields.description: The .NET date format string for the output, e.g. 'yyyy-MM-dd' or 'MM/dd/yyyy'. Defaults to 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

fields.name: NormalizedDataTable
fields.label: Normalized Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with normalized date columns.
